rationale: Price has reclaimed the gap-down open to reach 93.9% of the day's range, trading above VWAP ($28.60) and the 5m 9-EMA ($28.70) on 3.46× relative volume. The final five 1m candles display tightening consolidation with the latest printing a flat 28.75 body at the high of that bar and only 3–4 cent ranges. With 15 minutes left until mandatory market-on-close liquidation plus the earnings tape showing non-performing assets and loans more than double consensus, neither a long above the current level nor a short below today's high carries a clear mechanical edge.
